name: MITF-M melanocyte pigmentation program responsive to light
rationale: All members concern the MITF-M-driven melanocyte programme (melanin synthesis, pigment granules, melanocyte growth); unlike the confusables it includes UV-A/blue-light responses and melanin synthesis and lacks their cell-cycle/DNA-repair MITF-M arms.

name: Epithelial salt and water homeostasis under osmotic stress
rationale: Members cover cation-chloride cotransport, renal sodium/potassium handling and cellular water/ion balance; the hyperosmotic, salt-stress and osmosensory members separate it from confusables lacking osmotic responses, and it lacks their aldosterone and P-type ATPase content.

qualifier: from ER insertion to COPII export
name: Membrane protein biogenesis from ER insertion to COPII export
rationale: Members span SRP/tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER and COPII cargo export, whereas confusables emphasise ER folding, ERAD, COPI retrograde traffic or connexin transport.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling favouring cytosolic clearance
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium uptake, release and cytosolic calcium reduction (SERCA, ryanodine receptor, Na/Ca exchange); unlike confusables they lack positive release and cardiac contraction terms and include SERCA uptake.

name: Erythroid differentiation through terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation terms and erythroid modules up to terminal red-cell membrane assembly, distinguishing it from stem-cell/hematopoiesis and megakaryocyte confusables.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis by ornithine transcarbamylase
rationale: All members concern citrulline/arginine synthesis in the urea cycle, and the ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency members are what the confusables lack.

name: Antimicrobial protein killing of Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members describe direct microbe killing (cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity) against Gram-positive bacteria and yeast, unlike confusables centred on respiratory burst, degranulation or iron assimilation.

name: Glucose uptake and glycogen storage with inherited defects
rationale: Members cover intestinal/cellular hexose transport and glycogen synthesis/breakdown, many as inherited disorders; confusables have only one of these arms (transport or glycolysis/gluconeogenesis/galactose).

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling disrupted by cancer mutations
rationale: All members concern TGF-beta/BMP/activin receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation; the TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from closely overlapping confusables.

name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signalling tuned by co-receptors
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR proximal signalling modulated by CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22 and PECAM1, whereas confusables are T-cell-only activation and differentiation sets.

name: Plasma membrane solute carrier transport centred on amino acids
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated uptake of amino acids, peptides, urate and other solutes with their aminoaciduria disorders; amino acid and peptide carriers distinguish it from hexose and organic-cation confusables.

name: Vascular growth and remodelling across endothelium and smooth muscle
rationale: Members span VEGF/Tie-driven endothelial angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; confusables carry only one of these cell types or leukocyte-adhesion terms.

name: Amino acid metabolism featuring tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid synthesis/degradation (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, aromatic); tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism is what the close confusables lack.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal progenitor and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation (RUNX2, BMP, Wnt, mechanical load), distinct from chondrocyte, collagen-secretion and osteoclast confusables.

name: B cell activation and homeostasis through BCR signalling
rationale: Members describe B cell development, proliferation, survival and BCR signalling; confusables emphasise germinal-centre/plasma-cell identity or T cell programmes.

name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation via co-repressors
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 control of neuronal genes and its loss-of-function variants with linked sensory phenotypes; HDAC/NCoR co-repressor members separate it from behaviour-centred confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription control at initiation and termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation braking, termination and R-loops, unlike confusables centred on elongation/pausing or RNA processing and Pol I/III transcription.

name: Muscle calcium release and clearance favouring cardiac relaxation
rationale: Members regulate sarcoplasmic calcium release, Na/Ca exchange and cytosolic calcium reduction with negative control of cardiac contraction and heart rate, unlike confusables centred on SERCA uptake or positive inotropy.

name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis via BH3-only proteins
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of apoptotic genes and NOXA/PUMA-mediated cytochrome c release, combining what confusables split into p53 regulation or BAX/BAK permeabilisation.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members cover follicle development, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis, whereas confusables focus on gonadotropin secretion and hormone responses.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport in Hartnup and dicarboxylic aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are amino acid carriers and their disorders; Hartnup and SLC1A1/SLC6A14 members distinguish it from glycine/imino-acid and peptide-transport confusables.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organisation for spindle orientation
rationale: Members cover centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and astral microtubules for spindle orientation and asymmetric division, unlike cytokinesis, centriole duplication or mitotic centrosome maturation confusables.

name: Cell-surface protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members concern constitutive secretion and endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling of proteins, while confusables centre on Golgi-endosome-lysosome traffic or Rab/ARF regulators.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and adaptation with contractility regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, regeneration and adaptation plus contraction force and rate, distinct from smooth muscle confusables and from the calcineurin-hypertrophy confusable.

name: Golgi architecture remodelling through membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi disassembly/reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning with membrane tubulation, unlike confusables centred on COPI or secretory traffic.

qualifier: by excision and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base damage repair by excision and direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair (incl. defective glycosylases) and direct reversal of alkylated bases, the latter and the long-patch/defective-glycosylase members distinguishing it from confusables.

name: Rho and Cdc42 GTPase cycles centred on RhoA–C
rationale: Members are Rho-family GTPase cycles and formin activation; the RhoA/B/C cycles are what the closest confusables lack.

name: Bilirubin formation and hepatic clearance
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole degradation and hepatic organic-anion uptake, conjugation and export of bilirubin with hyperbilirubinemias, unlike drug-ADME confusables.

core: Glycine and imino acid transport defects
name: Glycine and imino acid transport defects causing iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are carrier variants causing iminoglycinuria/hyperglycinuria, absent from all confusables.

name: Motor coordination behaviour with cerebellar and striatal development
rationale: Members are locomotion, motor learning and reflex behaviours with cerebellar layer and striatum formation, unlike vocal/social behaviour or glial-development confusables.
